_note: Fixed customer-facing wording. Used for every deterministic outcome (sign-in, denials, slot requests, escalations, safety). The model only writes replies for informational answers, and those pass the output check.
message_too_long: That message is a bit long for me. Could you shorten it to the key question?
empty_message: I didn't catch a question there. How can I help?
images_unsupported: I can't look at images right now. Could you describe what you see in a message instead?
image_too_many: Please send at most {max_images} images at a time.
image_too_large: One of those images is too large. Please send images under {max_mb} MB.
image_bad_type: I can only accept JPEG, PNG or WebP images.
image_inappropriate: I can't help with that image. If you have a question about your {brand_name} order or shoes, I'm happy to help.
contract_violation: Sorry, something went wrong on my side. I've passed your conversation to our support team and someone will follow up.
injection_detected: I can only help with {brand_name} orders, products and stores, and I can't change how I work. I've flagged this conversation for our team. Is there something about your order or shoes I can help with?
generic_error: Sorry, something went wrong on my side. I've passed this to our support team so a person can help.
out_of_scope: I'm {brand_name}'s support assistant, so I can only help with our shoes, your orders, returns and exchanges, and our stores. What can I help you with?
clarify: I want to make sure I help with the right thing. Are you asking about one of these?
confirm_intent: Just to confirm, do you want to {intent_label}?
auth_required: To help with your order, I need to confirm it's you. Please sign in to your {brand_name} account, and I'll continue right after.
auth_failed: I couldn't verify your identity, so I can't show order details. You can try signing in again, or I can connect you with a person.
ask_product: Which {brand_name} shoe are you asking about?
ask_reference_size: What size do you usually wear, and in which system (US, UK or EU)?
ask_question: What would you like to know?
ask_size: Which size are you looking for?
ask_discount_code: Which discount code are you trying to use?
ask_return_reason: What's the reason for the return?
ask_exchange_target: What would you like instead: a different size, width or color?
ask_change_type: What would you like to change: cancel the order, or change the address or items?
invalid_order_id: That doesn't look like a {brand_name} order number. They start with SS followed by numbers, like SS10482.
invalid_size: I couldn't read that size. Could you give it as a number, like 8 or 8.5?
invalid_product: I couldn't find that product. Here are a few of ours:
invalid_discount_code: That doesn't look like a discount code. Could you type it exactly as written?
too_many_attempts: I'm having trouble getting this right. Let me connect you with a person who can help.
deny_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: I couldn't find that order on your account. Please check the order number, or pick one of your recent orders.
deny_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: I couldn't find that item in order {order_id}.
deny_ORDER_CANCELLED: Order {order_id} was cancelled, so there's nothing to return or exchange.
deny_NOT_DELIVERED: Order {order_id} hasn't been delivered yet. Once it arrives, you can return or exchange it within {return_window_days} days.
deny_RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED: Order {order_id} was delivered on {delivered_on}, which is outside our {return_window_days}-day return window, so I can't start a return or exchange for it.
deny_FINAL_SALE: {product_name} was a Final Sale item, so it can't be returned or exchanged.
deny_ALREADY_RETURNED: {product_name} from order {order_id} already has a return or exchange in progress.
deny_EXCHANGE_LIMIT: {product_name} has already been exchanged, and we allow one exchange per item.
deny_SAME_VARIANT: That's the same size, width and color you already have. What would you like to change?
deny_OUT_OF_STOCK: {product_name} in that size, width and color is out of stock{restock_note}. I can start a return instead, or you can pick another option.
deny_ALREADY_SHIPPED: Order {order_id} has already shipped, so it can't be cancelled. Once it arrives, you can return it within {return_window_days} days.
confirm_return: Please confirm: return {quantity} × {product_name} (size {size_us}, {width}, {color}) from order {order_id}. Estimated refund: {refund_estimate}.
confirm_exchange: Please confirm: exchange {product_name} from order {order_id}, from size {from_size} {from_width} {from_color} to size {to_size} {to_width} {to_color}.
confirm_cancel: Please confirm: cancel order {order_id} ({item_count} items, {total}). You'll be refunded to your original payment method.
action_cancelled: No problem, I haven't changed anything.
action_expired: That confirmation has expired, so I haven't changed anything. Just ask again if you'd like to continue.
action_not_found: I couldn't find that request, so nothing was changed.
done_return: Done. Your return {return_id} is set up. Print your label here: {label_url}. Your refund of about {refund_estimate} will be issued {refund_timing}.
done_exchange: Done. Your exchange {return_id} is set up. Print your label here: {label_url}. We'll ship size {to_size} {to_width} {to_color} once the original is on its way back.
done_cancel: Done. Order {order_id} is cancelled, and your refund of {total} is on its way to your original payment method.
escalated: I've passed this to our support team with the details of our conversation, so you won't need to repeat yourself. A person will reply during support hours ({support_hours}).
escalated_urgent: Thank you for telling us. I've passed this to our support team as a priority, and a person will contact you as soon as possible.
queued_intent_offer: You also asked about {intent_label}. Would you like help with that next?
fallback_answered: Sorry, I couldn't put that answer together properly. Let me connect you with a person, or you can try asking another way.
